cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — seated on a chair; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; a modern miniature railway museum's indoor demonstration platform — during an adult costume event she listens for the unseen model train; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a contemporary overnight train's small dining booth at sunrise — she enjoys a quiet pause before breakfast; a cobbled plaza before a Gothic cathedral with a fountain — holds her keepsake at chest height; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a bridal room — perched on a ledge or edge; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — standing; a convention photo zone under ring lights — holds a smartphone up at arm's length to take a selfie
